column7: \lemma complex-decomp (z : Complex) : z = fromReal z.re + i * z.im
\lemma euler {x : Real} : exp^i* x = fromReal (cos x) + i * sin x
\lemma exp^i*_+ {a b : Real} : exp^i* (a + b) = exp^i* a * exp^i* b
\lemma pow_exp^i* {a : Real} {k : Nat} : pow (exp^i* a) k = exp^i* (k RealField.* a)
